data.content_ref: inline:The claim rests on 'threshold-sensing' requiring infinitely long checklists, but this is not a causal mechanism—it is an unboundedness assertion. The target provides no evidence that objectively verifiable outcomes in practice depend on threshold phenomena that resist finite Boolean decomposition. The countercondition admits gestalt can be fully mapped into finite Boolean logic gates, which directly contradicts the 'infinitely long' premise, yet the target offers no mechanism for determining which class of tasks falls on which side, failing the problem's reliability-gain-vs-compliance distinction.
